newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK FIRMER AFTER ACTIVE DAY.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK FIRMER AFTER ACTIVE DAY.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar finished the week on Friday firmer against most hard currencies after a fairly active interbank session, dealers said.

"Some player was looking to sell U.S. dollars into the market and it looks like he sold in to a market that was already long and the dollar gained two cents from where it was mid-morning," a dealer commented.
The local unit closed at 10.6400/6600 against the key U.S. dollar from a low of 10.6650/6850 at opening. This compared with late Thursday's 10.6500/6700.
It was also firmer against the mark at 7.0460/0610 from 7.0590/0750 and was at 2.2630/2710 against South Africa's rand, slightly up from 2.2650/2720.
Against sterling however it weakened to 17.5510/5950 from 17.4940/5320.
